_comment: Hard level settings: default bonus/malus for every tile. A tile can have its own by adding "bonus" and/or "malus" in content/tiles.json. Then run python3 build.py again.

hard.order: Apply the tile's own effect first, then your bonus or malus. The tile you reach with a bonus or malus has no effect.
hard.finish: You already reached Net zero, so no bonus or malus here. Well played!
